dialogues.speaker: Chevreuse
dialogues.text: #How's it going, {NICKNAME}? Making every shot count?

choices.text: Sort of, though I don't exactly use guns.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Another skill is another choice you can make. Who knows? You might find yourself in a future situation where your usual combat skills are restricted.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: When that time comes, the option of using a musket at range will be open to you.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Hardly. There's no need to call it "advice." We'd just be sharing our experiences.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Turenna described your previous shooting form to me. From where I'm standing, you could well have the potential to become the best shot in Teyvat and even set new long-range records.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Of course, live combat situations, urban settings, and target-shooting challenges have their own unique features.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Use the musket in your hands a few more times, and I'm sure you'll uncover its secrets.

choices.text: Mind if I ask you for advice more often, then?
How are we getting on with our Natlanese friends, by the by?

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Oh? Well then, permit me to be frank.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: I suspect that if we wanted to recruit Miss Chasca, her base annual salary would come up to 60 million Mora.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Nope. That's the right figure.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: From the Maison Gardiennage's experience, building a piece of weaponry capable of matching her mobility and firepower would be...

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: ...Likely hundreds of billions of Mora in budget, several thousand engineers spread across multiple institutions, and over a decade of technical breakthroughs, R&D, and testing — and it still might not succeed.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: It's not at all hyperbole to call her and her Soulsniper a "Mora vault that flies."

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: When I watch her engaging targets, I find myself automatically converting each shot she takes into the cost of an equivalent musket round and cannon round...

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: From a cost-effectiveness standpoint, putting her on payroll at the salary we'd offer would be a steal. The figures are favorable enough to leave even the most cynical merchant in awe.

choices.text: This seems like it's gone well beyond a question of Mora...

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: I understand. She's also a holder of a Natlanese ancient name — that makes her one of the most important figures across all of Natlan.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Which is why I can really only express this wish to you.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: I'll think of other approaches — borrowing Miss Chasca's strength wherever possible, so the Special Patrol's capabilities can develop in a more well-rounded direction.

choices.text: She's got her duties at the Flower-Feather Clan, you know.
Got any topics that aren't about work?

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Good question.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: I think Miss Chasca would be well-suited to starring in a crime film — and absolutely in the leading role...

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Hmm, a paranormal adventure with a thriller edge to it would also be fitting. Investigating ruins, unearthing ancient powers, working around mysterious factions...

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Next time I see Director Xavier, I'll mention the idea to him in passing.

choices.text: Let me go look around some more.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Mm. Don't be impatient. Feel out the workings of the musket carefully — observe the tracer trajectories and the hit-confirmation signals... that flash of inspiration will find you sooner or later.

dialogues.speaker: Turenna
dialogues.text: Captain... Were you serious about what you just said?

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: I'll have to be carried through the air by a Qucusaurus, too?

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: That's right.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: And I'll have to practice handling the musket up there, shooting at ground targets at high speed?

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: That's right.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Then... is there a raise involved?

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: There is.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: I'm in!

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Honestly, even without the raise, I'd be in. Money's never the issue — the dignity of a Special Patrol officer is.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: If the Flower-Feather Clan's Saurian-riders can do it, I'm not about to admit defeat!

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Honestly, I knew you'd accept even without the raise — but I don't want to short-change anyone on the team. So beyond the raise, there'll be a series of supplementary insurance arrangements and stipends as well.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: To make sure you've got the stamina to handle harsher combat conditions, I'll be adding targeted physical conditioning training as well.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: Let's start with a 100,000-pace weighted run.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: I... I'll run. I'll run my best.

response.speaker: Turenna
response.text: Dangling in midair really does take it out of you, doesn't it? So for this 100,000-pace run, I'll carry fifty units of weight?

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: ...I was going to say thirty-five units.

response.speaker: Chevreuse
response.text: But since you're volunteering fifty, then Letellier can run the same standard. We'll see whether the others can take it after that.

choices.text: (Maybe I shouldn't listen to any more of this...)
